I re-measured every factual claim in the finding and all of them hold. The framing and the severity do not.

The pre-render sweep (`:3503-3508`) deletes only top-level `.html` files and build artifacts. No deletion call anywhere in `tools`, `scripts` or `server` touches `images/media`.

2. THE UNIT IS WRONG. "9 orphans" is a thin slice picked out by an incidental property (the source file is gone). The real issue is that "render never prunes `images/media/`". In chemistry, 2,290 published image files exist and 1,106 are referenced by no page in their dir (0 of them appear anywhere in that dir's HTML):

Two frozen evidence reports already record it (`verify-sidecar-lifecycle.md:222`, `explore-findings.txt:164`). They are evidence, though, not a to-do, so the "no register to-do" part of the claim stands.
